mariam: Quick sync  Need to lock banner + redirect plan for v1->v2 this week. I opened PR 2101 with draft copy and examples.

alex: Link?

mariam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2101

toni: skimmed. two asks: (1) show exact SDK error string so support can grep, (2) include a tiny embed-dim fallback snippet.

mariam: adding both. planned timeline: 21-day soft banner, 7-day prominent banner, 48h canary at 5%, then full redirect. Legal signed off on 21 days.

alex: ops wants path-level 301s for CDN caching. Also add rollback steps: toggle redirect flag + revert redirect map.

support-bot: Reminder: add labels `deprecation`, `migration`. CI will run snippet smoke tests on merge.

mariam: example error to include: "Error: 410 DeprecatedEndpoint: this endpoint has been removed, upgrade to client v2"

toni: embed fallback snippet (python):
```
def pad(vec, target=1536):
  return vec + [0.0]*(target - len(vec)) if len(vec) < target else vec[:target]

try:
  v = api.embed(model='embed-v2', input=text)
except ApiError as e:
  if 'dimension mismatch' in str(e):
    v = pad(api.embed(model='embed-legacy', input=text))
```

alex: good. I'll coordinate the canary with infra and schedule the rollout. Merge target: Thursday EOD.

mariam: thanks all  I'll update PR 2101 with the snippets, error text, and rollback checklist, then ping for review.
